description: The file defines a class `Chart_outcome_by_month` responsible for generating SVG chart XML data representing sales opportunity outcomes by month, with functionalities for data retrieval, caching, and chart rendering within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for constructing SQL queries, generating XML chart data, and handling user preferences and request parameters.

classes.name: Chart_outcome_by_month
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a sales outcomes chart by month, including data fetching, XML generation, and chart rendering, within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the chart, handles user input for date range and user selection, manages cache, and embeds the chart XML into the page.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML data for the chart based on date range and user IDs, performs database queries, and caches the result.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query string for fetching opportunity data based on user preferences and input.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the grouping columns for SQL queries; specifically 'month' and 'sales_stage'.
